title: AI for Business Innovation

requirements.title: Graduation-cohort restriction
requirements.summary: Students planning to graduate by May 2027 cannot declare this AI specialization, although they may take its courses. This restriction does not establish a first-offered date.

requirements.title: Declaration procedure
requirements.summary: Declare with the Business Major Specialization Declaration Form; submit a new form to change the specialization.

requirements.title: Recommended declaration planning
requirements.summary: The college suggests declaring after the fundamental marketing, finance, accounting and operations classes, while checking course sequences with an advisor. A senior-year change is discouraged because required courses may not run every academic year.

requirements.title: Multiple specializations
requirements.summary: Two specializations are allowed if all requirements can be completed, but a course cannot satisfy two specialization areas.

requirements.title: Transfer-credit approval and limit
requirements.summary: The Director of Undergraduate Studies must approve transfer courses. At most six transfer credits may count toward the specialization.

requirements.title: Transcript recognition
requirements.summary: Specializations are recorded on the transcript after graduation, rather than on the degree.
